task: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is how to play! Your first objective is to make an effort to travel south. That done, take a trip west. That done, make an attempt to move north. Following that, venture north. Then, attempt to go north. Then, pick-up the shirt from the floor of the closet. Alright, thanks!
description:
You arrive in a sauna. An ordinary one.

You make out a board. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a shelf. The shelf appears to be empty. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?

There is an unguarded exit to the north. There is an unguarded exit to the south. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
